harnesses.name: process_group::proofs::only_positive_identifiers_are_admitted
harnesses.contract: Only positive process-group identifiers can grant ownership to the reaper.
harnesses.bound: No loops or input assumptions; complete integer domain. Standard-library integer text decoding is checked by native and fuzz ingress round trips.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/process_group.rs ProcessGroup::new called by FromStr and the actual hidden node reaper CLI

harnesses.name: ordered_segments_stop_at_the_first_failed_write
harnesses.contract: Source, original frame, and payload preserve order and stop at the first partial-write refusal; flush happens only after every segment and its failure is returned.
harnesses.input_domain: Every byte in three two-byte segments, every admitted partial-acceptance count from zero through six, and both flush outcomes.
harnesses.bound: Six total bytes with unwind eight and unwinding assertions; std write_all runs against an actual one-byte partial writer. Native tests separately cover Interrupted, WriteZero, empty segments, and actual pipes.
harnesses.production: verification/outbound-proof.rs imports crates/domyjob/src/transport/input.rs directly; transport::exchange_input calls the same Outbound::send with actual child stdin.

harnesses.name: source_paths::proofs::tracked_path_records_are_bounded
harnesses.contract: Each byte transition respects record, path, count, and aggregate budgets and reports malformed record endings.
harnesses.input_domain: Every byte and all admitted usize counters: total bytes through 16877216, records through 100000, record bytes through 4096, and aggregate path bytes through 16777216.
harnesses.bound: Scalar per-byte transition with explicit admitted-counter assumptions; no complete UTF-8 or arbitrary-length parser claim.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths.rs PathBudget::advance and PathBudget::finish called by tracked_paths before portable-path construction

harnesses.name: source_paths::proofs::repository_metadata_is_excluded
harnesses.contract: Every listed repository-metadata component is excluded at root and nested positions while an ordinary path is admitted.
harnesses.input_domain: All sixteen fixed root/nested paths for eight metadata names and both metadata/ordinary control values.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; finite path fixtures, not all Unicode path strings or filesystem case-folding semantics.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths.rs metadata_path and metadata_component delegate to the production source_paths/metadata.rs classifier and scanner used by tracked_paths and the native ignore walker

harnesses.name: source_paths::proofs::repository_metadata_casing_is_excluded
harnesses.contract: Every ASCII uppercase/lowercase combination of each of the eight repository metadata names is excluded.
harnesses.input_domain: All six independent Boolean casing choices applied to every one of the eight fixed metadata names.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; complete stated finite ASCII casing domain, with all-uppercase and all-lowercase covers. No arbitrary Unicode or filesystem case-folding claim.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths.rs check_metadata_case invokes the actual metadata_component classifier after checked UTF-8 construction; tracked_paths and the native ignore walker use that same classifier

harnesses.name: source_paths::read_length::proofs::source_reads_are_bounded_and_exact
harnesses.contract: Source readers admit at most 64 MiB, inspect at most one extra byte, and accept exactly the admitted length.
harnesses.input_domain: All u64 expected lengths and actual byte counts, including over-budget and changed lengths.
harnesses.bound: No loops or assumptions; scalar admission, limit, and exact-length decision.
harnesses.production: crates/domyjob-core/src/source_paths/read_length.rs ReadLength::{new,limit,matches}; actual source_archive::Archive::add and source_fingerprint::hash_content apply Read::take and check consumed length

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::execution_records_preserve_command_outcomes
harnesses.contract: Recorded command completion preserves the exact exit code or launch failure and rejects unfinished or supervisor-only outcomes.
harnesses.input_domain: Every i32 exit code and all modeled job outcomes; one valid launch-error payload.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; strings are the fixed one-byte payload.

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::resource_budget_is_bounded
harnesses.contract: Admission accepts exactly the configured concurrent-job, memory, and swap bounds.
harnesses.input_domain: All u32 concurrent counts and all u64 memory quantities.

harnesses.name: resource_proofs::job_transitions_preserve_queue_and_terminal_invariants
harnesses.contract: Valid transitions preserve phase, PID, and outcomes; invalid transitions leave the state unchanged.
harnesses.input_domain: All modeled phases/events, all u32 input PIDs, all i32 exit codes; representative nonzero previous PID and one-byte launch reason.
harnesses.bound: Unwind 16 with unwinding assertions; finite phase construction, fixed reason payload.

harnesses.name: job_protocol::proofs::persistent_jobs_survive_client_actions
harnesses.contract: Disconnect preserves durable state, retries are idempotent, conflicts are rejected, and only active jobs can be reaped.
harnesses.input_domain: Every projection of the five recorded phases, all four durable states, and every action, including both request-equivalence values.
harnesses.bound: No loops or assumptions; complete finite enum domain.

boundaries.reason: The actual admission transition depends on filesystem identity, private candidate ACLs, operating-system selection/usage locks, directory publication, and the publisher-to-node lifetime. The segmented writer proof cannot establish these effects. Selection bridges publication to final usage admission because Windows refuses renaming a directory with open child-file handles.
boundaries.evidence: Native builds::tests on each supported host check a legacy exposed parent's protected candidate, a separate pruner blocked after publication until final usage admission, existing-winner and losing-installer admission, invalid/link refusal, and usage retained through the actual first-node callback. The original two-idle retention policy remains; fixtures make the candidate eligible using two newer idle companions. Replacement fixtures preserve the destination and recreated names and remove only an empty outer stage.
boundaries.reconsider: A native publication, selection, usage, identity, or cleanup contract fails, filesystem or locking semantics change, or the first-node ownership protocol changes.

boundaries.reason: Kani verifies the actual bounded Rust segmented writer, not CLR pinning/marshalling, PowerShell stdin inheritance, or overlapped Win32 completion semantics. The prefix reader retains its borrowed pipe handle, pinned bytes, event, and operation until native completion.
boundaries.evidence: The source-bound native Windows bootstrap scenario runs the actual script in Windows PowerShell and PowerShell 7, eight SDK inherited-overlapped-input schedules with exact binary prefix/remainder/EOF, and refusal without publication for truncated input, a write-only handle, and a failed pending observer. All hosts exercise the exact original frame, snapshot digest and bytes, isolated installer input/output, one upload/first-request connection, and primary-preserving cwd/cleanup faults.
boundaries.reconsider: The actual reader, shell launcher, byte-mode pipe assumption, FFI lifetime, source prefix format, or any native handoff contract changes.

boundaries.reason: The source-bound scalar budget/read-length and finite ASCII metadata proofs do not establish native Git configuration and index output, canonical root discovery, ignore matching, filesystem identity and concurrent mutation, capability-relative file opening, Windows reparse semantics, or tar publication. The actual source adapter merges validated tracked paths with the ignore walker, resolves the global excludes path through Git, anchors relative excludes and global patterns at the canonical repository root, and passes one retained selected-root capability to no-follow archive admission.
boundaries.evidence: Native source, source_archive, source_fingerprint and source_file tests cover Git-written global excludes paths with spaces and inherited config-count context, ignored tracked modified bytes, ignored untracked exclusion, deletion, real .GIT metadata, and subdirectory paths. Actual Git oracle fixtures cover ancestor-ignored untracked exclusion plus competing relative excludes files and repository-root anchored patterns without losing current tracked working bytes. Shared runtime/build readers retain every captured parent; Unix uses public cap-primitives open_dir_nofollow and safe rustix NOFOLLOW|NONBLOCK|CLOEXEC, while Windows NtCreateFile uses RootDirectory and OPEN_REPARSE_POINT for every component, rejecting non-disk/reparse handles before reads. Native controls replace inspected parents/final files, rename captured ancestors/root names, refuse a writerless FIFO within a killed/reaped child deadline, preserve read errors, and bound growth/truncation reads to admitted length+1. Native parser tests admit exactly MAX_PATH_BYTES in complete valid records and refuse one extra path byte separately from stream/count/record limits. Filesystem case folding and a single atomic view of concurrently modified files are not claimed.
boundaries.reconsider: Git output, ancestor ignore semantics, or capability/filesystem semantics change, a native source, link, budget, collision or archive contract fails, or a verifier can check the actual Git/filesystem adapter boundary.

boundaries.reason: The finite protocol step and job-state proofs do not establish filesystem locking, worker creation, SSH reliability, or native process lifetime.
boundaries.evidence: Native workspace tests exercise duplicate and conflicting submission, the existing launch-lock boundary, finished-job retries, launch refusal, and missing-supervisor state through the production app and Store adapters.
boundaries.reconsider: The launch or store locking protocol changes, a native adapter contract fails, or a verifier supports the actual filesystem and process boundary.

boundaries.reason: The supported native Kani, Quint/Apalache, Miri, and libFuzzer owner lane runs on Linux and Mac; native Windows verifier capability is not claimed.
boundaries.evidence: Linux or Mac: mise run verify and mise run miri on the exact source digest; Windows: cargo xtask verify inventory, cargo xtask windows-contracts, and mise run test for native SDK, process ownership, and filesystem contracts.
boundaries.reconsider: A pinned native verifier supports Windows, the implementation adds target-specific core decisions, or any native Windows contract fails.

boundaries.reason: Kani does not establish concurrent Win32 kernel ownership or foreign-function behavior.
boundaries.evidence: mise x -- cargo xtask windows-contracts; mise run test on Windows exercises capability, child ownership, failure cleanup, and process-tree termination.
boundaries.reconsider: A verifier supports the actual Win32 boundary, SDK semantics change, or a native ownership contract fails.
